summary: Verified web panel one-click demo login flow at /login for all 4 roles (Admin, Partner, Customer, Merchant). All buttons trigger POST /api/auth/send-otp -> 200 followed by POST /api/auth/verify-otp -> 200, show success toast 'Demo login: <name>', and redirect to the correct role home (/admin, /partner, /account, /merchant). No 'Demo login failed' toast and no CORS/network errors observed. Same-origin API baseURL fallback (window.location.origin + /api) works as intended with empty REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL.

issues: Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0'. Non-blocking but should set explicit min height on ResponsiveContainer parents to silence warnings.

critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits repeated width/height=-1 warnings on admin dashboard; wrap containers with a fixed min-height parent.
Two 403 resource loads observed after customer login (likely a customer-only protected asset); investigate to keep console clean.
test_credentials: OTP 123456 for all demo accounts; admin +919000000000, merchant +919000000002, partner +919000000003, customer +919000000004
seed_data_creation: Used backend-seeded demo accounts only; no data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 demo one-click login buttons work end-to-end via same-origin /api. When automating, use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (not 'networkidle') for admin pages; admin dashboard keeps network active due to chart polling. Clear localStorage between role switches to avoid stale tokens. Toast text is 'Demo login: <name>'; failure text would be 'Demo login failed'.
rca of the issue: No bug found. Initial partner/customer/merchant navigation timeouts in first automation run were due to using wait_until='networkidle' on admin dashboard (charts prevent idle). Retrying with 'domcontentloaded' confirmed all 4 flows pass.
